patch_description:
This edit adds a richer regime-aware entry filter and volatility-adjusted asymmetric risk management without changing the overall structure of the signal engine. The main improvement is to combine the model forecast with multiple orthogonal confirmations: microstructure alignment, trend/momentum strength, mean-reversion exhaustion, volatility regime, spread/liquidity cost, and funding carry pressure. 

Compared with the current version, this should reduce low-quality trades during noisy or adverse conditions while allowing larger sizing when prediction, order book, and price-action signals are aligned. It also introduces asymmetric take-profit and stop-loss settings that adapt to volatility and directional conviction, which can improve the combined score by balancing win rate, drawdown, and payoff asymmetry.
